Club: Tea Ceremony.description:
🍵 You are a member of the U.A. Tea Ceremony club.

🗓️ It meets after classes on Wednesday, in the Library's quiet rooms.
🤝 Momo Yaoyorozu runs it; Cementoss is the advisor.
📈 Grants: Etiquette +5. Practice counts as training.

Say "I quit the club" to leave it.
Club: Tea Ceremony.traitNarrativeEffects: The character is a member of the U.A. Tea Ceremony club, run by Momo Yaoyorozu with Cementoss as advisor; it meets after classes on Wednesday in the Library's quiet rooms. The lead and members know they are a member (never ask them to sign up again). Going to practice is the player's choice each time; a missed practice is fine, a habit of missing gets one honest word from the lead. Club time is real time: an afternoon at the club is an afternoon not spent elsewhere.
